limitations: Shared local WSL VM; CPU scheduling and frequency are not exclusive or controlled.
Controls are a separate earlier rotating series, not interleaved with the Laramago paired samples.
Full Composer checks and hosted CI have not been run for this candidate.
Profile CPU sections are nested; metadata RPC can overlap callbacks; do not add nested section totals to callback totals.
Only nullable syntax cache calls/hits/misses are instrumented here. Cache capacity, payload and eviction telemetry are unavailable.
Private project paths, identities, messages and input/diagnostic fingerprints are excluded.

excluded_attempts.reason: Earlier native source seal included Docker absolute paths; rejected before analysis.
Earlier workload profile interrupted when user selected a fresh application checkout.
Initial new-workload native control exhausted the parent CLI default 128 MiB during JSON decoding; discarded and rerun with parent 2 GiB.

additional_reference_input_audit.note: Additional source/reference-tree audit, excluding generated bootstrap/cache and public/storage. Ctimes corroborate absence of mutations; this is separate from the per-observation selected-input and dependency seals.

interpretation: Targeted parse work is reduced. Shared-VM timing variability is larger than the median difference; a robust whole-command speedup is not isolated. Larastan controls were collected in a separate earlier series.
